answer: it reads storage nothing wrote.  Re-filling every allocated cache with 0.125 instead of 0 -- which a correctly masked attention cannot observe -- moves exactly the rows that were already known to wobble, and the earliest row it moves is 8.
not_a_claim: this says nothing about whether the DEVICE is right; it bounds the region in which the comparator can be quoted at all
the fill is not a claim about what the caches OUGHT to hold: it is a control, and a masked read cannot see it either way
the vendor's kernels are unmodified -- the buffers this fills are the ones the oracle harness allocates on the device
